title: Applications & results
subtitle: Your supervisor suggests universities, you approve them and the team sends the applications. Every result is recorded here.

quota.label: Your contract's applications
quota.title: {{used}} universities added, of {{total}} applications in your contract

awaiting.title: Waiting for your approval
awaiting.subtitle: Nothing is sent until you approve. Each decision is recorded once.

preparing.title: Being prepared
preparing.hint: You approved it; the team is preparing the university's form.

sent.title: Sent, waiting for a result
sent.hint: The university has it and will announce the result.

decided.title: Result in
decided.hint: Your supervisor records each result as soon as it arrives.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.text: Your contract includes {{total}} applications. None have been added yet, which is normal: applying starts after writing and documents.
empty.textNoTotal: No universities have been added yet, which is normal: applying starts after writing and documents.
empty.stageText: Your supervisor updates the case's stage. Once it reaches “Apply”, suggested universities show up here for your approval.

documents.title: Documents & writing
documents.text: No application is sent without complete documents. See what's waiting for you.

interests.title: Research interests
interests.text: The search team uses them to find suitable professors and universities. A few words in English are enough.

supervisor.title: Have a country or university in mind?
supervisor.text: Tell your supervisor now so it's part of the search.

pick.title: Your supervisor suggests a university
pick.text: With the program, deadline, application fee and the reason.

approve.title: You approve or reject it
approve.text: Nothing is sent until you approve.

result.title: The team sends it and the result shows here
result.text: You also get a ticket with each result.

result.waiting_for_portal: Waiting for the portal to open

approval.confirm: Reject the application to {{university}}? It won't be submitted.
approval.error: That didn't go through. Check your internet connection and try again.

offer.title: Congratulations! Your admission is in
offer.question: May Scorize show this admission on its website, with your first name?

professors.subtitle: Professors we emailed for you, matched to your research interests.
